summary.en: A pixel-art Space Invaders remake with level progression and sound, written in deliberately teachable code.
summary.zh: 像素风太空侵略者复刻，带关卡推进与音效，代码风格教学向。

description.en: Slide your cannon along the bottom and pick off the descending alien fleet while dodging return fire. Clear the screen and the next wave comes faster and thicker.
description.zh: 左右移动炮台射击下压的外星舰队，躲避子弹；清空一屏进入下一关，敌人速度与数量递增。

tip.en: The commit history reads like book chapters — one lesson per commit — which makes it a ready-made 'build your own game' textbook. A natural fit for a retro-arcade section.
tip.zh: 章節式 commit 历史（每步一个 commit），想教人做游戏可以直接拿它当教材。适合做站点的「复古街机」栏目。
